methods.description: Actual workflow condition and shell-command controls bind ordinary full package verification to the existing regression-zero producer, mandatory controls, build, native readback, current-head input receipt and successful upload. Exact proof requires the producer and status consumer. Selected-data and evidence package execution remain genuine; Cloudflare labels do not claim the independent Sites reserve measurement.

limits: Focused controls model the GitHub status-expression subset present in the actual workflow and execute its gate/receipt shell bodies against bounded fixtures. They are not a hosted Actions run or a fresh application/GPU/Canvas/scientific execution.

Prior observed parallel full and package job durations establish duplicate runner work, not additive wall-time savings. No measured savings or first successful ordinary full-route execution after this change is claimed before it is observed.

Full test inventory, package builders, model-reader custody, science and selected-data browser/parity requirements are unchanged. The separate main-push Sites package budget workflow remains the actual archive/file reserve gate; Cloudflare compilation does not claim that measurement.

The initial hosted full activation exposed two existing PR-gate workflow fixtures whose old dependency and status-function assumptions were omitted from the first focused list. Those adjacent fixtures are corrected and their actual full suite is included; the first hosted failure remains recorded, not relabeled as success.
